# Detailed Service Documentation & Technical Scope

## AI & Automation (/services/ai-automation/)

**Overview**: We automate repetitive operations with conversational AI assistants, automated lead routing, and intelligent data pipelines built around your business goals.

**Definition & Use Case**: AI and workflow automation is the application of intelligent chatbots, API pipelines, and autonomous data extraction tools to eliminate manual repetitive overhead. It is intended for operational teams seeking faster response times, reduced clerical error, and uninterrupted lead qualification without expanding administrative headcount.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Do AI chatbots hallucinate or provide inaccurate company facts?**
  A: No, when engineered correctly with retrieval-augmented architecture. We restrict chatbots to answer strictly from your approved knowledge base, instructing the system to escalate to human staff whenever an inquiry falls outside verified documents.
- **Q: Will implementing automation require replacing our existing software tools?**
  A: No. Our automation pipelines bridge your existing applications via standard APIs and webhooks, ensuring your current tools remain in place without disruption.
- **Q: Is customer data kept secure when using AI automation?**
  A: Yes. We configure direct API integrations that process data within protected enterprise endpoints, ensuring commercial details are never used for public model training.
- **Q: How long does a typical workflow automation project take to deploy?**
  A: Standard conversational chatbots and CRM pipelines typically deploy within 2 to 4 weeks, while complex multi-system enterprise workflows take between 4 to 6 weeks.
- **Q: What happens if a connected third-party API goes offline?**
  A: We implement automated retry queues and instant administrator notifications, preserving incoming payloads safely until the external endpoint restores connectivity.
- **Q: Can an AI chatbot book consultations directly into our calendar?**
  A: Yes. We integrate conversational assistants directly with calendar scheduling APIs like Google Calendar or Cal.com to verify real-time availability and confirm bookings.

## Custom Software Development (/services/software-development/)

**Overview**: We architect robust web applications, internal operational software, cloud dashboards, and scalable SaaS platforms with 100% intellectual property transfer.

**Definition & Use Case**: Custom software development is the engineering of tailored web applications, internal portals, and SaaS platforms built around specific business workflows. It is intended for growing businesses that need proprietary functionality, automated operational processes, or direct IP ownership without recurring third-party licensing fees.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Do we retain 100% intellectual property ownership of the code?**
  A: Yes, absolutely. All software code, database scripts, cloud configurations, and documentation belong 100% to your company upon milestone completion. You can host it anywhere and modify it freely.
- **Q: Which technologies do you use for custom software development?**
  A: Our primary stack is Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Docker, and Python. We prioritize scalable, community-backed open-source technologies that avoid proprietary lock-in.
- **Q: How do you handle post-launch maintenance and feature updates?**
  A: Every project includes warranty support for bug fixes and system stabilization. For ongoing feature development, we offer dedicated agile engineering sprints or monthly retainers.
- **Q: Can your custom software integrate with our existing accounting or CRM tools?**
  A: Yes. We specialize in building secure API connectors with existing tools like Tally, Zoho, Salesforce, WhatsApp Cloud API, payment gateways, and custom database servers.

## Mobile App Development (/services/mobile-app-development/)

**Overview**: We design, build, and maintain mobile applications for smartphones and tablets, focusing on clean user experiences, stable offline functionality, and secure backend integration.

**Definition & Use Case**: Mobile app development is the process of designing, programming, testing, and deploying software applications for iOS and Android devices. It is intended for businesses that need persistent customer engagement, device-native hardware access, offline capabilities, or dedicated mobile transactional workflows.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: How do you decide between native and cross-platform mobile development?**
  A: The decision depends on performance requirements, hardware access needs, and budget. Cross-platform engineering allows one unified codebase to run on both iOS and Android, which reduces development time and maintenance overhead for most business applications. Native development is recommended when applications demand intensive 3D graphics, low-level hardware control, or platform-exclusive capabilities.
- **Q: Who owns the mobile app source code and intellectual property?**
  A: You retain 100% ownership of all source code, design assets, and intellectual property upon completion of the project and milestone settlement. We transfer the complete repositories and deployment configurations to your organization.
- **Q: How are app store submissions managed for Apple and Google?**
  A: We guide you through setting up Apple Developer and Google Play Console accounts under your corporate entity, compile the necessary cryptographic release certificates, assemble store listing metadata and screenshots, and submit the binaries for review.
- **Q: Can an existing website backend be used for a mobile application?**
  A: Yes. If your current website or web platform exposes secure REST or GraphQL APIs, mobile applications can connect directly to your existing database and business logic without rebuilding your backend infrastructure.
- **Q: How do you handle mobile application testing across different phones?**
  A: Testing is conducted on real physical devices and device simulators across different screen sizes, operating system versions, and network speeds to ensure stable performance before release.
- **Q: What maintenance is required after a mobile app is launched?**
  A: Mobile apps require ongoing maintenance to remain compatible with annual iOS and Android operating system updates, third-party library security patches, and changing app store guidelines.

## Web Development (/services/web-development/)

**Overview**: Engineering high-performance, secure, and future-proof web applications designed to scale your operations effortlessly.

**Definition & Use Case**: Web development is the engineering, programming, and optimization of internet applications and websites. It is designed for businesses requiring fast-loading digital portals, customer-facing interfaces, or conversion-focused platforms that represent their brand credibly and turn visitors into sales leads.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Which programming languages and frameworks do you use?**
  A: We specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Python for custom development.
- **Q: How do you handle website maintenance after deployment?**
  A: We offer structured maintenance agreements covering framework upgrades, cloud security patches, database backups, and ongoing uptime monitoring.
- **Q: Which programming languages and frameworks do you use?**
  A: We specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Python for custom development.
- **Q: How do you ensure fast page load speeds?**
  A: We leverage static generation, image optimization, responsive asset sizes, and clean code without bloated third-party page builders to achieve top Core Web Vitals.
- **Q: Do we own the website code after it is launched?**
  A: Yes, 100%. Upon project completion, all source code, design assets, and deployment configurations belong entirely to your company.
- **Q: Can we manage website content ourselves?**
  A: Yes. We can integrate lightweight headless content management systems or structured markdown content files so your team can easily publish updates.

## Digital Growth (/services/digital-marketing/)

**Overview**: We engineer search engine optimization, generative engine optimization (GEO), and conversion strategies built around your business goals.

**Definition & Use Case**: Digital growth is the systematic optimization of search engine rankings, generative AI engine citations, and conversion journeys to capture active commercial demand. It is intended for businesses seeking dependable organic visibility across Google search, map listings, and modern AI answer engines without relying exclusively on ad spend.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?**
  A: GEO is the practice of optimizing website content, factual entities, and structured data so that AI search assistants (like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews) can easily understand, retrieve, and cite your brand as an authoritative source.
- **Q: How long does it take to see results from SEO?**
  A: Technical fixes and indexing improvements often show measurable search ranking movement within 4 to 8 weeks, while competitive commercial keyword rankings and consistent organic inbound inquiries typically mature within 3 to 6 months of steady execution.
- **Q: Do you guarantee #1 rankings on Google?**
  A: No ethical SEO agency guarantees specific #1 rankings, as search algorithms update frequently. We focus on transparent technical standards, high-quality content, and measurable conversion growth built around your business goals.
- **Q: What is the difference between Local SEO and National SEO?**
  A: Local SEO optimizes your Google Business Profile and local citations to attract clients within a specific geographic territory (e.g. Rishikesh, Dehradun), whereas national and international SEO targets high-intent keyword searches irrespective of geography.
